purpose: Execute independent mission streams and alternate paths concurrently, converge them through one proof-gated sovereign fan-in, and preserve the mission kernel's authority and completion invariants.
invariants: The execution graph is immutable and bound to one mission contract and one Formation plan hash.
Only VERIFIED_LIVE capability attestations enter automatically compiled snapshots.
Ready waves exclude unresolved dependencies, unavailable capabilities, active collision keys and exhausted budgets.
Claim transactions recheck dependencies, concurrency, collisions and cumulative cost atomically.
Claims are single-owner, expiring and monotonically fenced.
Logical worker failure is contained to its path and does not cancel healthy siblings.
A verified result's producer is the current claimant and its distinct verifier matches the proof authority fingerprint.
Sovereign fan-in requires current independent proof and equal-or-better quality.
One mission-version effect group has at most one selected candidate.
Candidate selection never performs or authorizes an external effect.
An active execution graph blocks mission terminality.

A measured real-mission 2x claim requires at least 30 paired observations and a one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of at least 2x with quality, proof, security and cost preserved; synthetic workloads remain labeled SIMULATED_SCHEDULING_SPEEDUP_ONLY.
